concept.title: View a report
concept.shortdesc: After a report is created, an email is sent to the user on the day

conbody.p: After a report is created, an email is sent to the user on the day that the report was requested. For example, if you opted to receive reports every Monday, you will receive an email on Monday 8:00 GMT with a View report link.
You can also view a generated report directly on the web application.
